style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean Nordic baking-kitchen ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, warm sand #EFE7DC, brushed steel grey #B9BDC0 and graphite #2E3236; neutral bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and fill card, narrow skimming highlight on brushed metal and soft contact shadows only; surfaces limited to warm oak butcher block #C8A67C, tan silicone baking mat #C2A88C, pale speckled quartz #E8E9E6 and light oak #D9C3A5; modern geometric sans-serif in thin weight with all in-image copy left as blank slots; thin single-weight line icons in graphite; stable round-platform product angle and scale with a blank unlit display and unlabelled buttons; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no digits, units or legends rendered on the display or buttons
no brand marks, wordmarks or badge artwork on the body
style.presentationRules: the round platform stays parallel to the frame edge, the display window stays blank and unlit, the two flanking buttons stay unlabelled, body thickness never exaggerated
